method: UI in Claude in Chrome session, the test account, pt-BR, Free plan. No automation was activated, tested or run. Nothing was sent.
steps_run: Opened Automações > Cenários (/automation/automations): tabs Todos, Ativada, Pausados, Desativada; search box; tag filter (crown).
Row menu > Renomear: dialog 'Renomear a automação', renamed the draft to ZZ_TEST_automation_1, toast 'Automação renomeada'.
Row menu > Duplicar: no dialog was visible. After a reload the list had a second row '[COPY]ZZ_TEST_automation_1' (ID 2, Desativada).
Row menu > Ver detalhes: dialog with 'Criada em', 'Última edição', 'Descrição' and 'Editar descrição'. Closed without editing.
Row menu > Registros de acesso (/automation/logs/scenarios): tabs 'Logs de cenários' and 'Contatos no cenário'; no data to read.
Row menu > Ver relatório (/automation/stats/<id>): per-step cards, 'Nenhum dados ainda'; refresh toast 'As estatísticas foram atualizadas.'
Opened /automation/settings/<id>: re-entry toggle with wait time, exit conditions, reinitialization conditions, button 'Salvar condições'. Nothing changed.
Saw the row menu entries 'Atribuir uma tag' (crown) and 'Excluir'; Excluir was not pressed.
observations: Duplicar acts immediately. An agent must not click it twice: each click creates another copy.
The list does not refresh after Duplicar; a reload is needed to see the copy.
Activation was not tried: the account has marketing e-mail sending suspended and activation would start real processing.
limitations: Activate, test, delete, description edit and reentry/exit changes were observed as UI elements but not executed.
